extra.build: sprout.data.extra_sources.main(cap=10**9, out_name='extra_train_full'): the same copy checks as extra_train.csv with no per-class cap. The extra stage checks the removed-by-cap count against the 7,303 of docs/extra-sources.md and records the manifest's hash in results/e15/extra_full.json; the train stage refuses a manifest that differs from that file.

class_rule.real_train_is: field_train rows plus extra_train rows of the class (all of them, uncapped)
class_rule.test_use: field_test rows are only counted per class for this rule; no photo of it is opened or scored

model.name: convnextv2_tiny
model.weights_license: cc-by-nc-4.0 per the Hugging Face model card of timm/convnextv2_tiny.fcmae_ft_in22k_in1k. The facebookresearch/ConvNeXt-V2 LICENSE file has an MIT section and an Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 section and does not say which covers the weights, so the weights are treated as non-commercial. Both were read through a summarizing fetch, not verbatim. Local non-commercial research use is fine; publishing or any commercial use of weights derived from them needs the person's check.
model.onnx_precheck: An untrained model of this architecture (pretrained=False, 29 classes) exported to ONNX (opset 17, dynamic batch) and quantized with onnxruntime quantize_dynamic QInt8 on CPU, 2026-11-04: fp32 ONNX output differed from torch by 7.7e-7, the quantized file was 28 MB against 111 MB, outputs finite. Mechanical check only; accuracy after quantization is T5.1's.

settings.note: E4's convnext_joint settings (configs/e4.json arm 1) except the model, the per-pass draws and no lab cap. One run, one seed, no search.
settings.lr_change_rule: Only if the first passes clearly train badly (training loss not falling, or non-finite); the change and its reason go in the run record.

draws.real: Per class and pass, real_per_class photos from field_train plus the uncapped extra rows, split evenly across the sources present in that class (remainders go to randomly chosen sources, new each pass). A source with fewer photos than its share repeats them, each used the same number of times plus or minus one. Nothing is deleted.
draws.lab: Per class and pass, lab_per_class photos from lab_train, drawn afresh each pass; repeats only if a class has fewer.
draws.rng: numpy default_rng([seed, pass, 1]) for real and [seed, pass, 2] for lab

compare.rows: field_dev rows that are in clean version 1 and whose true class is one of the 29 (subset final_classes+clean:1). The same rows for every system.
compare.rescore: Keep rows whose true class is one of the 29, set the other classes' outputs to zero, renormalize each row, then score. Fixed before any score was seen; the same for E4, E12 and E1.

decision.rule: Keep the best of the three: the highest macro-F1 on the compared rows (final_classes+clean:1) among convnextv2_final, E4 (convnext_joint) and E12 (convnext_joint_extra). A tie goes to convnextv2_final, then E4, then E12. The chosen model serves the 29 classes. E12's G3 failure and the keep-E4 decision stay as history. Fixed before any convnextv2_final score existed; E4 and E12 rescored numbers had already been seen in a dry run.

refit.green_note: The green share is a property of the photo, not the model, so the refit reuses E5's file for field_dev and not_plant_dev.
refit.healthy_rule: healthy_threshold = abstain_threshold + (1 - abstain_threshold) / 2: a photo whose top label ends in the suffix must clear this, every other label the abstain threshold. Fixed before any score; the cost is reported, healthy photos are not deleted or reweighted.
refit.rows: the same compared rows as the E15 record (cleaned, 29 classes)
